POWER MECHANICS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for ISO Thread forms.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ISO Thread forms.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ISO Thread forms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.

2. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

4. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

5. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

6. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.

7. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.

8. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Suspension system.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.

9. When learning Steering system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Steering system.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Steering system.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Steering system.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Steering system.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

12. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.

13. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Limits, fits and tolerance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.

14. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

16. When learning Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Metalwork processes in power mechanics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
